assets.prompt: Create a wide 4:3 papercraft garden stage for a preschool shape game. Bright blue textured paper sky fills most of the frame, with three soft white cut-paper clouds, layered rolling green hills, deep-green bushes and large leaves framing only the lower edges, and a handful of pink, yellow, purple, and orange paper flowers along the bottom corners. Keep the central 60 percent spacious and uncluttered for gameplay. Straight-on overhead presentation, physical paper fibers, visible scissor-cut edges, upper-left light and soft down-right shadows. No characters, lettering, interface, border, gradients, or watermark.

Asset contact sheet on a perfectly uniform near-black charcoal background. Arrange exactly fifteen separate handmade construction-paper pieces in a clean 3-by-5 grid with wide gutters and nothing touching: blue circle, yellow triangle, green square, coral rectangle, mint oval; golden scalloped sunburst, yellow right triangle, coral right triangle, blue trapezoid, cream circle; waffle-textured tan cone triangle, pink circle, orange square, blue rounded rectangle, cream square. Every piece must be front-facing, fully visible, centered in its cell, free of text, and have believable paper fibers plus a restrained soft down-right shadow. No labels, props, glow, border, or watermark.

assets.rejectionReason: The first pass used atmospheric glow that broke the tactile paper-world lighting and complicated clean extraction.
